initiating-force-wrong.reason: Absolutism is too rigid; self-defense context matters.

competition-drives-progress.reason: Struggle as progress engine is unfounded.

ban-extremist-parties.reason: Democracies can defend themselves against anti-democratic parties.

vanguard-party.reason: Disciplined vanguard leadership is not required.

priority-to-poor.reason: Helping the poor should be a high priority.

restrict-strikes-picketing.reason: Restrictions on strikes undermine worker rights, though some limits okay.

population-causes-poverty.reason: Not the main cause of poverty.

price-controls-essentials.reason: Price controls often backfire but may help in crisis.

party-controls-media.reason: Government control of media threatens freedom.

party-commands-army.reason: Armed forces should be under civilian, not party control.

long-naturalization-wait.reason: Ten years seems long, but standards vary.

representatives-worker-pay.reason: Pay limits would deter talent; unrealistic.

party-discipline-binding.reason: Mandatory party discipline conflicts with independent judgment.

pool-sovereignty.reason: Some pooling has merits, but sovereignty tradeoffs.

defeat-own-government-war.reason: Working people have no duty to want defeat.

recall-officials.reason: Recall is a reasonable accountability tool.

abolish-rental-housing.reason: Prohibiting rental housing would harm supply.

people-in-arms.reason: Armed citizenry replacing army is impractical.

reunify-divided-nation.reason: Reunification can be legitimate but depends on consent and circumstances.

cultures-equal-different.reason: Cultural equality is nuanced; some practices are worse.

death-penalty.reason: Torn on capital punishment; wrongful convictions worry me.

restrict-pornography.reason: Some restrictions like for minors reasonable.

religious-exemptions.reason: General laws should apply broadly with limited accommodations.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.reason: Debt relief debated; some cases justified.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.reason: Restricting freedoms for growth is not justified.

rich-countries-aid-poor.reason: Wealthy countries have moral duties to help.

central-bank-independence.reason: Independence has benefits, but accountability and stability matter.
